items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: They had a band there they called McGrudy... I listened to them good, you know. And I know good music when they played it, you know.

ctx.x: Do you remember what kind of music you used? Any of the pieces or what kind of, uh, some kind of dance music, of course. Was it mostly for dance? You said concerts, though, too, didn't you?

Yeah, for dance, for dance, sometimes for dance. We went play in a place they called Fudo's once. They had a band there they called McGrudy. They was playing, you know. But after we come in there, you know, they stopped and, oh. Oh yeah. I wanted to hear your band. Yeah, but they had piano and everything in there. They could play alright. I listened to them good, you know. And I know good music when they played it, you know. And so, we'd play for them. We'd come back with a loaded outfit, you know, such as…
Can you tell me anything more about the music? What kind of dancing they had in those days? Were they waltzes or two steps or foxtrot or quadrille or what kind of music was it?
